title: Becker’s “116 Healthcare Cybersecurity Companies to Know — 2025” List: Medcrypt Named
summary: Becker’s Hospital Review includes Medcrypt in its 2025 list of “116 Healthcare Cybersecurity Companies to Know,” highlighting our growing influence and innovation in health IT security.
body_markdown:
*Becker’s Hospital Review* published its **“116 Healthcare Cybersecurity Companies to Know — 2025”** list on September 15, 2025, featuring key players contributing to healthcare cybersecurity across hospitals, health systems, and medical technology vendors.[Becker's Hospital Review](https://www.beckershospitalreview.com/healthcare-information-technology/cybersecurity/116-healthcare-cybersecurity-companies-to-know-2025/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)


In this annual, nomination-based list, Becker’s emphasizes that it is **not a ranking** but a recognition of noteworthy companies advancing security in the healthcare domain.[Becker's Hospital Review](https://www.beckershospitalreview.com/healthcare-information-technology/cybersecurity/116-healthcare-cybersecurity-companies-to-know-2025/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)


Medcrypt’s inclusion alongside major players reinforces our relevance in the competitive health IT security landscape and enhances our visibility to hospital IT leadership, medical device manufacturers, and cybersecurity decision-makers.
